name: vitamin-d-icu-mortality

review.citation: Vitamin D supplementation and mortality among critically ill adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Frontiers in Nutrition, 2026.

question: Vitamin D supplementation and mortality among critically ill adults
criteria_source: Transcribed from the review's section 2.2 (Selection criteria).

criteria.population: Critically ill adults (age > 18 years, with no upper age limit)
criteria.intervention_or_exposure: Vitamin D or a vitamin D metabolite, without restriction on type, dosage, duration or route of administration (oral, enteral, intravenous or intramuscular)
criteria.outcomes: Mortality in critically ill adults as the primary outcome (90-day, then 28-day, then hospital mortality)
exclusion: Studies that reported only ICU mortality
Case reports, conference abstracts, reviews, comments and post hoc analyses
Earlier reports of the same patient population (only the most current update is included)

included_source: Section 3.1: '21 studies were included in the meta-analysis (19, 20, 25-43)'; reference numbers mapped to PMIDs from the review's JATS reference list.
search_query: (vitamin D[tiab] OR 25-hydroxyvitamin D[tiab] OR calcitriol[tiab] OR cholecalciferol[tiab] OR ergocalciferol[tiab]) AND (critically ill[tiab] OR critical care[tiab]) AND (intensive care[tiab] OR ICU[tiab])
